stations.title: Lorcan's test
stations.text: One test for all rules. It just says failed.

stations.title: Terminal
stations.text: The failing test's name says which rule.

captions: Effie changed the subscription code, and a test failed without saying why.
Lorcan's one test checks every rule at once, so its failure cannot name the cause.
You write one test per rule, grouped and named, and split Lorcan's test.
Now when a rule breaks, the failing test's name says which rule it was.
Same code, same rules. The terminal tells Effie where to look.
